ops.title: Keep LR post receipts and reply references internal under origin-numbered CCI
ops.description: Owner: /root/long_running_watch_flakes_ship. Root explicitly assigned this separate boundary while native read/cursor task3dce ships independently. CCI#177/a578 preserves JSON record.seq internal but human post receipts now use Record.Name/num and post --re/--resolves resolve human origin numbers; LR stores internal IDs and parses POSTED bare integers. Non-owner/mixed-origin metadata can therefore target or match the wrong record. Next: inspect existing structured post --json and shared native Store.Post/CLI reference helpers; build one explicit machine input/output projection preserving internal IDs end-to-end, human numbering unchanged, without scattered numeric conversions/fallback/migration. Isolate CCI post.go and LR post/reference candidate from provider readFlags/root.go scope. CI real mixed-origin/non-owner post/reply/resolve/receipt equivalence and historical persisted-ID evidence, independent review, normal merge/release/serialized installed affected-case proof required. No local tests/builds/benchmarks/live forced work/signals. Native read/cursor task3dce and urgent orphan taskb2495 are independent.

ops.text: Actual LR post receipt/reference consumers and existing structured APIs are source-attributed; mixed-origin/non-owner CI reproduces precise internal-vs-human ID mismatch without guessing.

One shared explicit machine reference/output boundary preserves internal IDs and human CLI behavior; independent exact source review and real CLI/LR CI checks pass, no conversion scatter/fallback framework.
Normal merge/publication/coordinated installation and actual installed affected-case/source adoption verify the separate post/reference fix, with limits explicit.
